headline: Claude AI reports degraded performance across multiple models
summary: Users are experiencing issues with Claude's AI models, with the company acknowledging performance degradation. Updates are being provided via email and text.
details: Anthropic, the company behind the AI chatbot Claude, has reported degraded performance affecting multiple of its AI models. The exact cause and extent of the degradation are not yet fully detailed.
Users experiencing issues can subscribe to receive updates via email and text message. Anthropic will notify subscribers when incidents are created or resolved.
This incident highlights the ongoing challenges in maintaining consistent and optimal performance for large-scale AI models. Further details are expected as the situation develops.
caption:
Claude AI is experiencing degraded performance across multiple models. Users can subscribe for real-time incident updates.

Anthropic, the company behind the AI chatbot Claude, has reported degraded performance affecting multiple of its AI models. The exact cause and extent of the degradation are not yet fully detailed.

Users experiencing issues can subscribe to receive updates via email and text message. Anthropic will notify subscribers when incidents are created or resolved.

This incident highlights the ongoing challenges in maintaining consistent and optimal performance for large-scale AI models. Further details are expected as the situation develops.
